name: Universal TV Section Dividers
description: Adds clear visual dividers between page sections for better content separation on TV

params.css: section, [role='region'], article + article, main > div + div { border-top: 1px solid rgba(48,54,61,0.8) !important; padding-top: 24px !important; margin-top: 24px !important; } h2, h3 { margin-top: 32px !important; padding-top: 16px !important; border-top: 1px solid rgba(48,54,61,0.4) !important; } article + article { margin-top: 32px !important; }
